page.overview:
What is Challenge Dungeon?

Challenge Dungeon is a location in the original version of Final Fantasy Legends: Hikari to Yami no Senshi for feature phones. In the enhanced port for smartphones, localized as Final Fantasy Dimensions, it is dummied.
